name: get_session_data_properties
full_description: Returns custom session property names, data types, and distinct session counts, optionally restricted to sessions with a selected property. Select a saved Umami host_id. Original upstream: GET /api/websites/{websiteId}/session-data/properties.

host_id.description: Saved Umami connection ID. Obtain it from hosts_list.

startAt.description: Start of the date range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

endAt.description: End of the date range as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

propertyName.description: Name of the custom event or session property.

query.description: Filter by page URL query string.

os.description: Operating system used by the visitor.

device.description: Device category used by the visitor.

region.description: Region or subdivision of the visitor.

tag.description: Tag attached to the tracked activity.

hostname.description: Hostname on which the activity occurred.

distinctId.description: Custom identifier assigned to the visitor.

language.description: Preferred language reported by the visitor browser.

excludeBounce.description: Set a non-empty value to exclude visits with only one pageview.

segment.description: ID of a saved segment used to filter results.

cohort.description: ID of a saved cohort used to filter visitors.

eventType.description: Event type: 1 for a pageview or 2 for a custom event.

match.description: Whether records must match all filters or any filter.

period.description: Relative date range, for example 7d or 30day, used instead of an explicit startAt/endAt range.
